requirements.quote: QTYPE fields appear in the question part of a query.
requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing the QTYPE field of a query.
requirements.required_behavior: Locate the QTYPE field in the question part of the query.
requirements.why_checkable: The query serializer and parser expose the section containing the QTYPE field.

requirements.quote:
QTYPES are a
superset of TYPEs, hence all TYPEs are valid QTYPEs.
requirements.condition: When determining whether a QTYPE value is valid.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat every valid TYPE value as a valid QTYPE value.
requirements.why_checkable: The accepted QTYPE value set can be checked to contain every valid TYPE value.

requirements.quote: AXFR            252 A request for a transfer of an entire zone
requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting the AXFR QTYPE.
requirements.required_behavior: Map QTYPE value 252 to a request for transfer of an entire zone.
requirements.why_checkable: The AXFR encoding and QTYPE dispatch mapping can be checked for value 252 and entire-zone transfer semantics.

requirements.quote: MAILB           253 A request for mailbox-related records (MB, MG or MR)
requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting the MAILB QTYPE.
requirements.required_behavior: Map QTYPE value 253 to a request for mailbox-related records MB, MG, or MR.
requirements.why_checkable: The MAILB QTYPE mapping and its selected record types can be inspected or exercised.

requirements.quote: MAILA           254 A request for mail agent RRs (Obsolete - see MX)
requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting the obsolete MAILA QTYPE.
requirements.required_behavior: Map the obsolete MAILA QTYPE value 254 to a request for mail agent resource records.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation that handles obsolete MAILA can be checked for its QTYPE value and request interpretation.

requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting the wildcard (*) QTYPE.
requirements.required_behavior: Map QTYPE value 255 to a request for all records.
requirements.why_checkable: The wildcard QTYPE encoding and request interpretation can be checked against value 255.
